params.caption: 🎮 Fan project brings lost Elder Scrolls spin-off Shadowkey to PC An Elder Scrolls fan is reviving Shadowkey, the long-forgotten spin-off made for Nokia's N-Gage phone, and porting it to PC. The project also upgrades the game, with AI used as part of the work, as PC Gamer reports. 🕒 Nov 11, 2026 · 03:00 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: PC Gamer #ElderScrolls #PCGaming #GamingNews
